variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: Home for a brand-new account: the first-access screen. Inside ConsoleLayout, clicking the prompt (or pressing Enter on it) opens the layout's command palette; type a domain such as example.com (taken) or acme.example.com (available) into the second door to run the availability check.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: Populated Home whose data could not load: the usage band and every resource panel show a danger `Alert` with Retry in place of their content; the greeting and the agent card stay.

variants.name: Summary
variants.summary: The classic overview: four metric StatTiles with a Hint on each label and the window they cover in a caption, a resources DataTable card and a Recent activity DataTable card, each with a View all footer Link, beside an aside of a Monthly usage list card and a Marketplace trends card that pages through featured templates with Previous and Next.
